description: A consumer account's association of an Amazon Redshift data share another account authorized for it, made with Redshift's AssociateDataShareConsumer. Set exactly one of AssociateEntireAccount, ConsumerArn, or ConsumerRegion. AWS replaces an entire-account association with a namespace or Region one, and the other way around, so a deploy that would replace another association fails and changes nothing.

DataShareArn.description: The ARN of the data share the producer authorized for this account.

AssociateEntireAccount.description: Whether to associate the data share with the entire account.

ConsumerArn.description: The ARN of the consumer namespace to associate the data share with, or of an AWS Glue Data Catalog.

ConsumerRegion.description: The Region whose existing and future namespaces get the data share.

AllowWrites.description: Whether the consumer accepts writes to the data share. AWS uses false when it is left out.

ProducerArn.description: The ARN of the producer namespace.
